---
title: "![](assets/logo.svg){.brand-mark .light-content}![](assets/logo-dark.svg){.brand-mark .dark-content}**laplacekit**"
---

An extensible, modern Laplace-approximation library for PyTorch, built on a plugin system.

Every Laplace method, on any model. Curvatures, likelihoods, priors, predictives and model integrations are all plugins, and the built-in ones are written the same way as yours. It runs on `torch.func` and Curvlinops.

```bash
pip install laplacekit
pip install "laplacekit[transformers]"  # lk.transformers: Laplace-LoRA on language models
pip install "laplacekit[diffusers]"     # lk.diffusers: diffusion models
pip install "laplacekit[all]"           # every first-party plugin
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Classifier

```diff
+ import laplacekit as lk

  model = train(model, train_loader)
  logits = model(x_test)
- probs = logits.softmax(-1)
+ post = lk.laplace(model, train_loader, likelihood=lk.Categorical())
+ probs = lk.predict(post, x_test).probs
```

## Regression

```diff
+ import laplacekit as lk

  model = train(model, train_loader)
- y_pred = model(x_test)
+ post = lk.laplace(model, train_loader, likelihood=lk.Gaussian())
+ pred = lk.predict(post, x_test)
+ y_pred, y_std = pred.mean, pred.stddev
```

## Language model

```diff
+ import laplacekit as lk

  model = train(get_peft_model(model, lora_config), train_loader)
  inputs = tokenizer(prompts, return_tensors="pt", padding=True)
- probs = model(**inputs).logits[:, -1].softmax(-1)
+ post = lk.transformers.laplace_lora(model, train_loader)
+ probs = lk.predict(post, inputs, select=lk.transformers.last_token).probs
```

:::

**laplacekit** picks the parameters, the curvature and the prior; `print(post)`
shows what it chose. In the language model tab, `last_token` reads each
prompt's last real token, so padding does not matter.
